text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 200, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "friend's house 200 miles away"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 70, "unit": "mph", "kind": "count", "span": "speed of 70 mph"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 10, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "detour that added 10 miles"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 240, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "route home that is 240 miles"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 80, "unit": "mph", "kind": "count", "span": "he goes 80 mph"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "distance out, including the detour"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "hours driving out at 70 mph"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q4", "q5"], "out": "s3", "note": "hours driving home at 80 mph"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "both legs together"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many hours the whole trip took"}, "dismissed": []}
